description: Use when a merchant asks whether a high-risk merchant account review may fit their business. Inputs are the niche, monthly processing volume, country or entity, the current processor if any, and what happened (for example a shutdown, a limitation, a fund hold, or a new business). Returns a qualitative fit of likely good fit, needs review, or outside this app's scope, the documents people typically prepare, a qualitative timeline, and a link to the RetryHub application when the category is in scope. Does not approve an account, quote fees, or promise a timeline. Do not send card numbers, government IDs, or bank details.

country_or_entity.description: Country of the business entity, such as United States or Germany.

current_processor.description: Current or previous processor name, if the merchant mentions one.

monthly_processing_volume.description: Monthly card volume in the merchant's own words, such as $80,000.

niche.description: Business niche or vertical, such as skincare subscriptions.

what_happened.description: What happened: shutdown, limitation, fund hold, or a new business. No account numbers.

name: match_merchant_account
title: Match a merchant account
